Ability/Acid Flask.description: Throws acid up to 3 tiles away: 4 to every enemy on and around the tile, and 3 Acid that eats them for 3 turns.

Ability/Bite.description: Bites a tower or the base next to it.

Ability/Blink.description: Teleports to a free tile up to 5 tiles away, over anything in between.

Ability/Bolt.description: Fires a heavy bolt for 25 at an enemy 2 to 4 tiles away.

Ability/Bombard.description: Lobs a shell 2 to 3 tiles away: 30 to every enemy on and around the tile.

Ability/Brute Walk.description: Walks up to Speed tiles along its path, stopping where its attack can reach the target it wants.

Ability/Crush.description: Crushes the base, or a tower, next to it for its Power. It goes for the base unless taunted.

Ability/Example/Chain Lightning.description: Hits an enemy for 60, then jumps to 2 more enemies nearby.

Ability/Example/Execute.description: Hits an adjacent enemy for 30. Not ready the turn it arrives; after a cast it waits until its owner kills something.

Ability/Example/Fire Wall.description: Sets a tile on fire for 2 rounds: 10 damage to whoever starts a turn on it.

Ability/Example/Fireball.description: Hits everything within 1 tile of the aimed tile for 100.

Ability/Example/Pinning Shot.description: Hits for 10 and roots the target.

Ability/Example/Provoke.description: Taunts an enemy up to 3 tiles away for 2 turns: when it can reach this tower, it attacks it.

Ability/Example/Raise Skeleton.description: Raises a Skeleton that falls when its summoner dies.

Ability/Example/Shield Bash.description: Hits an adjacent enemy for 80 and pushes it 2 tiles.

Ability/Example/Volley.description: Hits up to 3 random enemies within 3 tiles for 5 each.

Ability/Firebolt.description: Hurls fire up to 3 tiles away: 8 to everyone on and around the tile it hits, your own towers and base too, and sets them burning (2 a turn for 2 turns).

Ability/Guardian Taunt.description: Taunts an enemy up to 2 tiles away for 2 turns: when it can reach the Guardian, it attacks the Guardian.

Ability/Hop.description: Hops up to Speed tiles along its road, over anything in its way.

Ability/Mend.description: Heals a hurt tower up to 4 tiles away for 10.
Ability/Mend.targetFilter: Target.IsAlly and not Target.HasTag(Base) and Target.Hp < Target.MaxHp

Ability/Nibble.description: Nibbles a tower or the base next to it.

Ability/Path Walk.description: Walks along its path, up to Speed tiles.

Ability/Quicken.description: Speeds itself up: 1 more Speed, twice at most.

Ability/Rally.description: Every ally within 2 tiles gets 2 more Power and 1 more Speed for 2 turns.

Ability/Ram.description: Rams the base for 5 and dies doing so.

Ability/Shoot.description: Shoots an arrow for 10 at an enemy up to 2 tiles away.

Ability/Slam.description: Slams the ground: twice its Power to every tower next to it.

Ability/Slime Mend.description: Heals a hurt enemy up to 3 tiles away for its Potency.
Ability/Slime Mend.targetFilter: Target.IsAlly and Target.IsUnit and Target.Hp < Target.MaxHp

Ability/Smash.description: Smashes an adjacent tower or the base for its Power: the one furthest ahead on its path, the nearer on a tie.

Ability/Smite.description: Smites an enemy up to 3 tiles away for 5, or 15 against a boss. The Priest's other abilities wait one more turn.

Ability/Spark.description: Zaps an enemy up to 3 tiles away for 10.

Ability/Spit.description: Spits at a tower or the base up to 2 tiles away for 5.

Ability/Tower Walk.description: Moves the tower up to Speed tiles.

Ability/Fire Shot.description: Shoots a burning arrow up to Range tiles away: the target burns (2 a turn for 2 turns).

Ability/Fire Volley.description: Rains burning arrows on a tile up to Range tiles away: every enemy on and around it is hit and burns (2 a turn for 2 turns). 2 turn cooldown.

Ability/Venom Shot.description: Shoots a poisoned arrow up to Range tiles away: acid eats the target (2 a turn for 3 turns).

Ability/Long Shot.description: Shoots a heavy arrow at an enemy up to Range tiles away.

Ability/Shield Bash.description: Slams an adjacent enemy with the shield and pushes it back 1 tile.

Ability/Fireball.description: Hurls a big fireball up to Range tiles away: everyone on and around the tile it hits is hit and burns (placeholder).

Ability/Frost Bolt.description: Hurls an icy bolt at an enemy up to Range tiles away and pushes it back 1 tile (placeholder).

Ability/Chain Spark.description: Zaps an enemy up to Range tiles away; the spark jumps to 2 more enemies nearby (placeholder).
